citation: Historic American Buildings Survey. Chicago Water Tower, 806 North Michigan Avenue, Chicago, Cook County, Illinois. HABS IL-1041 (HABS ILL,16-CHIG,104-), measured drawings (sheets 1-3: site plan, plans A-A, B-B and C-C, and the west elevation and section, 1994), with photographs and data pages. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
author: Historic American Buildings Survey (National Park Service)
describes_date: 1994 (the tower as surveyed; built 1867-1869 and unaltered in its stonework)
repository: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division (HABS/HAER/HALS collection), item il0097. Photograph 1 (from the north-east) is committed at data/sources/assets/landmarks_1871_t3689/habs_il1041_photo1_from_northeast.jpg.
locator: Sheet 2: plans A-A (the base, 43 feet square outside, 51 feet across the corner turrets, the floor four feet above the ground), B-B (the 25-foot upper stage) and C-C (the octagonal shaft, 15 feet 6 inches across). Sheet 3: the elevation, with the observation floor at 151 feet 6 inches, the cupola from 161 feet 6 inches to 173 feet 6 inches and the mast's top at 182 feet 6 inches. Photograph 1: the tower from the north-east across Michigan Avenue, the pumping station's corner turret at left.
rights_note: Works of the U.S. Government (National Park Service, HABS). LOC: 'No known restrictions on images made by the U.S. Government'.
access_notes: Read 2026-11-20 (T-3689) from the Library's sheet images (tile.loc.gov, service/pnp/habshaer/il/il0000/il0097/sheet/00002v.jpg and 00003v.jpg) and photograph 061196pv.jpg; the photograph committed at 810 x 1024 px, sha256 b922470fde2ee3b827ba5a4078e0bcd949f1201482e23fb547fc65b2bde3303b.
note: A 1994 survey of a tower that has stood unchanged in its stonework since 1869 and survived the fire; the owner asked (2026-11-20) that modern pictures be used to tune it. Its heights are read off sheet 3 in feet and turned into metres.
what_it_supplies: the tower's plan at three levels and every principal height
the forms of its doorways, windows, gables, turrets and battlements
what_it_does_not_supply: the pumping station across the street
anything about 1871 as such: the 1871 stereograph is that witness
